stemMd: A block slides on a horizontal rough surface and slows to rest. Which statement about energy is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Its mechanical energy is transformed mainly into thermal energy of the block and surface.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Friction must increase its kinetic energy.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Its gravitational potential energy necessarily rises.

explanationMd: Friction does negative work on the sliding motion, reducing kinetic energy. At the microscopic level, energy is transferred to disordered motion and deformation, commonly becoming heat. Mechanical energy alone is not conserved, but total energy is.

distractorRationale.c: Energy is transformed rather than destroyed.
distractorRationale.b: The observed slowing shows kinetic energy decreases.
distractorRationale.e: The surface is horizontal, so height need not change.
distractorRationale.d: Stopping does not require loss of mass.
